sql: SELECT reqHost AS host,toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfHour(reqTimeSec)) AS hour_epoch,endsWith(reqPath,'.ts') AS is_ts,count() AS requests,countIf(reqPath LIKE '%.ts' AND statusCode IN (200,206) AND extract(reqPath,'[-_](\\d+)\\.ts$') != '') AS ts_eligible,sumIf(bytes,reqPath LIKE '%.ts' AND statusCode IN (200,206)) AS video_bytes FROM Veto_Streamin.logs WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(1794767400,'UTC') AND reqTimeSec < toDateTime(1794853800,'UTC') GROUP BY host,hour_epoch,is_ts ORDER BY host,hour_epoch,is_ts SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60
